personality_one_liner: A cinematic, deeply dark, and expensive-feeling marketplace where high-contrast gold accents and glassmorphism elevate Indian event services into a premium D2C experience.

spacing.rule: Generous and cinematic. Elements should have room to breathe, feeling like a high-end catalog rather than a dense dashboard. Use lg/xl around major containers.

do's: Apply frosted glass (expo-blur) to sticky headers over scrolling content.
Apply to the bottom tab bar when content scrolls behind it.
Apply to floating action buttons (FAB) over a brandTertiary tinted bg.
Use a gradient scrim (dark to transparent) layered under glass for readability.
Apply to 'Featured/Trending' vendor cards resting over imagery.
dont's: Do not apply glass to form inputs or body content regions.
Do not stack more than two glass surfaces per screen.
Do not use glass if the text on top fails WCAG contrast requirements.

screens.name: Customer Home
screens.purpose: A visually striking entry point showcasing premium event categories, featured packages, and top vendors.

states.loading: Centered gold spinner on deep dark surface.
states.empty: Luxe illustration of an empty banquet, subtle gold accents, inviting user to search.
states.error: Elegant text message 'Unable to load experiences' with a gold 'Retry' button.

screens.layout: Top bar: Location selector on left, Search icon on right. Hero section: Large cinematic carousel of premium events (weddings, banquets) with a top-to-bottom gradient scrim and glassmorphism text overlay. Primary category row: Horizontally scrollable tabs (Weddings, Sangeet, Corporate, Birthdays) with gold-tinted icons. Trending section: Horizontal cards showcasing vendors with cover imagery, gold rating, and distance. Combo packages section: Large cards with rich background images and glass-elevated detail boxes.

screens.name: Vendor Detail
screens.purpose: To immerse the user in the vendor's work and provide a frictionless path to booking.

states.loading: Skeleton UI with subtle dark shimmer.

screens.layout: Large hero image gallery covering the top 40% of the screen. A dark gradient scrim at the bottom of the image ensures the overlay text (Vendor Name, Rating) is readable. Sticky horizontal tabs below the hero: About, Services, Reviews, Gallery. A persistent 'Book Now' primary CTA anchored at the bottom inside a glass container. A floating 'Ask AI' button with a subtle gold glow.

screens.name: Search & Filters
screens.purpose: High-contrast search surface with robust filtering for specific event needs.
screens.layout: Full-screen dark mode input with immediate recent searches below. Popular category chips (pill shape, surfaceTertiary). Filter sheet slides up (bottom-sheet) with sliders and toggles, applying a blur over the search results.

screens.name: Checkout & Cart
screens.purpose: A secure, premium summary of the service booked, leading to Razorpay UPI payment.
screens.layout: Single-column layout. Order summary card (surfaceSecondary) showing date, guests, and services. Price breakdown with subtle dividers. Sticky 'Pay via UPI' gold button at the bottom.

screens.name: Vendor Dashboard
screens.purpose: An elegant operational command center for vendors to manage their business.
screens.layout: Top section: High-level analytics tiles (Views, Revenue) in dark cards with gold metric typography. Mid section: 'Upcoming Bookings' horizontal scroll. Bottom section: Availability Calendar showing blocked dates. Clean, utilitarian but retaining the dark-luxe aesthetic.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the '6 Glass / Luxe DARK' personality. The background must remain deep charcoal/midnight (#0B0C10), and the accent must be Gold (#D4AF37). Do NOT introduce purples, blues, or any AI-default neon gradients.
Dark mode is the default and primary theme. Text on the deep background should be #F3F4F6 for softness, but text on the Gold primary brand color MUST be dark (#0B0C10) for WCAG AAA contrast.

Any text placed on top of imagery (like hero carousels or vendor cover photos) MUST be backed by a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to #000000) starting at 50% height and reaching >70% opacity at the bottom. Never overlay text blindly on images.
Use 'Cormorant Garamond' (serif) for display/headings and 'Geist' (sans-serif) for body and UI elements. Limit font weight to 400 or 500 max. Use size to establish hierarchy, not extreme weights.

Apply 'expo-blur' (glassmorphism) for elevated surfaces like sticky headers, the bottom tab bar, bottom sheets, and featured cards floating over imagery. Ensure readability by tinting the glass base appropriately.
Include the Haptics feedback definitions in interactive components as specified.

For the Vendor List / Detail screens, mimic a premium Urban Company / Zomato District flow but elevated: high quality imagery, elegant typography, and a sticky gold 'Book Now' CTA anchored at the bottom inside a glass container.
